_comment: Only read once: when accounts are first set up, these become the first admin's betting rules (Accounts.bootstrap()). After that each user sets their own rules on the Betting tab, saved with their account, and this file isn't used. 'mode': 'off', 'paper' (bets are recorded, nothing is sent to Kalshi), 'demo' (orders go to Kalshi's test exchange, play money) or 'live' (real-money orders), the last two with the user's own Kalshi key. A game gets a bet when the AI odds beat the ask on one side by at least 'min_edge' (0.05 = 5 points); each bet buys as many contracts as 'stake_usd' covers, and bets stop for the day once 'max_daily_usd' (cost + fees) is used up. Only sides priced between 'min_price' and 'max_price', with at least 'min_ais' AIs answering, in 'leagues', during the parts of the season in 'segments', are bet on.
